caption: The drawing depicts a single dark-colored frog, positioned centrally on an off-white or light beige background. The frog is rendered in shades of dark brown and black, with some lighter accents suggesting natural markings and highlights on its limbs and along its back. The frog's posture shows it slightly crouched with its rear legs bent beneath its body and its front legs splayed outward. The drawing style is realistic, with attention paid to the texture and form of the frog's skin. In the lower right corner of the image, there is a small, simple outline sketch of the frog, annotated with measurement marks and arrows, likely providing scale or reference for the main drawing. The composition is minimalistic, with the frog as the solitary subject and the majority of the background left blank.
title: Cast Iron Frog
